probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is defined as having a degree of flexibility sufficient to maintain a seal under operational conditions.

3. (Currently amended) The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, and the tapered portion is defined by an included angle of less than 40 degrees.

7. (Currently amended) The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is defined by an included angle of less than 40 degrees.

9. (Currently amended) The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, wherein the compliant seal is defined as having a degree of flexibility sufficient to maintain a seal under operational conditions.

10. (Currently amended) The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, wherein the compliant seal is defined as having a degree of flexibility sufficient to maintain a seal under operational conditions.

11. (Currently amended) The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, wherein the compliant seal is defined as having a degree of flexibility sufficient to maintain a seal under operational conditions.
